payload.text: The hrc document, instanced: one node per seat, generation, runtime and annotation; containment is the lineage hierarchy
KEY
hrc.seat  the continuity · key sessionRef · metadata lives here
hrc.generation  one per host session · ordered · attention is its field · live 24 h after its runtime ends
hrc.runtime  the process · key runtimeId · attachable
hrc.annotation  client-owned JSON on a seat or generation · key subject + ns + kind + id · opaque to HRC

nesting  = the lineage hierarchy (project › seat › generation › runtime | annotation; seat › annotation)      dotted  = mirrors one store row      green  = folded from the ledger, never stored on the node
